name: Yunnan Copper Co.,Ltd
summary: Yunnan Copper Co.,Ltd engages in the copper exploration, mining, and smelting activities in China. It is also involved in extraction and processing of sulfur chemical, rare and precious metals. The company explores for gold, silver, lead, zinc, and other related mineral resources. It offers cathode copper, gold, silver, industrial sulfuric acid, and rare and dispersed metals such as molybdenum, platinum, palladium, selenium, and tellurium under the Tiefeng brand. In addition, it engages mining copper and other associated and related precious metal; import and export of goods and technologies, mineral products, and metal products.
